title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Correspondence Standard for Case Notices and Successor Contact
content:
This correspondence standard fixes, for each Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases plan, who receives case notices, how they are sent, the notice timing figures, and what may be said to a possible successor before confirmation.

## Recipients and delivery

| Case plan | Who receives case notices | Delivery method |
|---|---|---|
| Death of Last Surviving Borrower | the successors and the estate | first-class and certified mail |
| Sale or Title Transfer | the borrower | first-class and certified mail |
| Extended Health-Care Absence | the borrower and the borrower's representative | first-class and certified mail |
| Principal Residence Change | the borrower | first-class and certified mail |
| Property Charge Default | the borrower | first-class and certified mail |
| Property Condition Default | the borrower | first-class and certified mail |

## Timing figures

| Case plan | Due-and-payable notice sent within (after the loan is called due) | Minimum days between the foreclosure referral notice and the referral |
|---|---|---|
| Death of Last Surviving Borrower | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Sale or Title Transfer | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Extended Health-Care Absence | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Principal Residence Change | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Property Charge Default | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Property Condition Default | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |

## Successor contact settings

| Case plan | Caller must be a confirmed successor in interest before declaring intent or requesting an extension on a deceased borrower's loan | What a potential successor may be told before confirmation | Documents that confirm a successor in interest |
|---|---|---|---|
| Death of Last Surviving Borrower | yes | only the list of documents needed | letters testamentary, letters of administration, a small estate affidavit, a recorded deed |
| Sale or Title Transfer | no | not applicable | none listed |
| Extended Health-Care Absence | no | not applicable | none listed |
| Principal Residence Change | no | not applicable | none listed |
| Property Charge Default | no | not applicable | none listed |
| Property Condition Default | no | not applicable | none listed |

## Notes on the standard

- Under the Death of Last Surviving Borrower plan, a caller who is not yet a confirmed successor may be given only the list of documents in the last column. The four listed documents are the whole set of documents that confirm a successor in interest under that plan.
- Each figure above is a number of calendar days. Business days are not used.
